DuplicatesScreen.description: Of every work, its likeliest pair of every other site: every field the sites share is compared, the text itself aside — the title, the description, the tags, universes, characters, pairings, the status and other values, the size. First the pairs where the score by the formula of the work the pair was looked for times the chance the pair is one work is higher. "One work" links them as the work's window does: the grade and the interest become shared. "Different" — the pair is offered no more. The answers teach the model of the chance.
DuplicatesScreen.learntHint: The chance of one work is a model fitted on your answers "one work" and "different"; fitted again a few seconds after an answer
DuplicatesScreen.neverSearched: The pairs were never looked for yet. Press "Search again".
DuplicatesScreen.notLearntHint: No pair is marked "one work" yet: in place of the chance, the mean likeness of the shared layers
DuplicatesScreen.searchHint: Compare every work of every site anew, by the vectors of their titles and descriptions as they are now. In the background, in the queue of the computations; the answers are kept
DuplicatesScreen.sortHint: What the chance of one work is multiplied by: the interest and the predicted grade of the work the pair was looked for (of both, when each is the other's likeliest, the larger). The choice is kept in the browser
DuplicatesScreen.title: Duplicates across the sites
PairRow.chanceHint: The chance this is one work: by the model of your answers (before the first "one work", the mean likeness of the layers)
PairRow.differentHint: These are different works: a link, if any, is taken away, the pair is offered no more
PairRow.facetsHint: How alike the two works' values of this facet are; a rare value weighs more than a common one. How much the facet tells of one work, the model learns from your answers
PairRow.partialHint: One holds a part of the other's text — one site has only some of its chapters, or one is a collection the other is in (the volumes of a series are different works): each its own grade and interest; the pair is offered no more, the model does not learn from it
PairRow.priorityHint: The score by the formula of the work the pair was looked for (of both, when each is the other's likeliest, the larger) times the chance of one work: what the pairs are ordered by
PairRow.relatedHint: Another relation of the two works: a translation or a part
PairRow.sameAuthorHint: By the dictionary of authors the works have an author in common: one normalized author, or authors marked as partly one
PairRow.sameHint: This is one work: link them as the work's window does; the grade and the interest become shared
PairRow.sizeHint: How alike the size is: the smaller over the larger in words and parts, their mean
PairRow.title: titles {{value}}
PairRow.translationHint: One is the translation of the other: different works of one text, each its own grade and interest; the pair is offered no more. The model does not learn from translations: their authors differ, their tags and descriptions are one
PairRow.unanswerHint: Take the answer back: the link, "different", "translation" or "partly" goes, the pair returns to the unanswered
WorkSide.estimate: Worked out of the site's other number by how many words the work has to a character
